title: The Yale Student, Banking And Papers: Implementation Matrix

basisKey.documented: The rule is the institution's or the law's, read in a cited source.
basisKey.simplified: The rule follows a cited source, with a stated simplification.
basisKey.design: Original SLATE design, labelled as such where the player meets it.
basisKey.uncertain: The source doesn't settle it; SLATE's labelled assumption.

features.goal: Begin as a first-year in the MFA in Acting
features.prereqs: A new life; the owner-approved talent from the class's top quarter
features.choices: Birthplace (US citizen or F-1 student), bank, family means
features.steps: Arrive in New Haven on 24 August 2026, a week before classes
features.stateRW: Person.school, documents (F-1 for a foreign birthplace), primary account
features.consumers: Every school system; Papers status; banking eligibility

tests.title: the admitted class

features.limitations: The August 17–21 international pre-orientation isn't modeled; the Certificate route isn't modeled.

features.goal: Register for the program
features.entry: Orientation's registration session (24–29 August), or School screen catch-up
features.prereqs: In New Haven; a session's time passed for catch-up
features.choices: Attend the session, or catch it up late
features.steps: Session or catch-up, as long as the session
features.failure: Unregistered: classes count as unexcused absences, shifts can't be worked (I-9), SSN can't be applied for
features.recovery: Late registration, with the chair's written permission taken as given
features.consumers: Classes, work-study shifts, the F-1 SSN application
features.notices: 'Not Registered' each class day missed for it; 'A Shift You Couldn't Work'
features.saveLoad: registeredAt saved; a save from before registers by its orientation record

tests.title: unregistered, classes don’t count them

features.limitations: What Yale's registration involves beyond enrolment isn't published past login; I-9 timing is SLATE's reading.
features.resolution: Fixed: registration gates classes, shifts and the SSN.

features.goal: Meet the class and the faculty, and learn what the School asks
features.entry: Orientation sessions on the calendar; School screen catch-up
features.prereqs: In New Haven, out of hospital, awake
features.steps: Classmates met; faculty set out the policies; the tour shows the studios and library; expectations set the first work
features.failure: Missed sessions: classmates unmet until the first class, studios and library unknown
features.consumers: Partner asks need classmates met; studio and library steps need the tour; the Standing tab's policies
features.notices: Each session's text; the policies kept under What The School Asks

tests.title: catches up a session missed by hand
catching it up late counts them from then

features.limitations: The sessions' real content is behind a Yale login; SLATE's faculty session states the Bulletin's policies.
features.initialGap: The faculty session named teachers and changed nothing.
features.resolution: Fixed: it sets out the policies, kept readable on the Standing tab.

features.goal: Attend classes, or be excused when ill
features.entry: The calendar's class days; Call In Sick on the School screen
features.prereqs: Registered; in New Haven and awake at nine
features.choices: Go, call in sick, or stay away
features.steps: Classes run nine to three on class days
features.states: attended, excused, missed per day and per course
features.failure: Unexcused absence counts against attendance and the course
features.recovery: Excused by a sick day, a hospital stay or a lay-up
features.consumers: Term evaluation; course pass; coursework showings
features.notices: 'You Missed Classes'; the sick-day refusal explains why where it can't be used

tests.title: can’t be called in sick from on a day with nothing at school

features.limitations: One evaluation a term; the faculty's 'any time' action is a grave breach only.

features.goal: Prepare and show coursework
features.prereqs: Open work; feedback read; partner asks answered; time before the next commitment; fit for on-your-feet steps
features.choices: Which step, which approach, table-work answers
features.steps: Read, prepare parts, rehearse, show at the course meeting
features.states: open → shown/revising → done; missed; excused; lapsed
features.failure: Not shown unexcused counts as unready; feedback reflects the evaluation's chief limit
features.recovery: Excused showings move to the next meeting, or are excused at a course's last
features.consumers: Term evaluation's coursework; course pass; casting's evidence

tests.title: counts a piece not shown

features.limitations: Feedback words are SLATE's, marked simulated.

features.goal: Rehearse with a scene partner
features.entry: Coursework tab: ask, answer, call off
features.prereqs: Classmate met; 24 hours ahead; no clash; trust above wary
features.steps: Book, then meet
features.states: booked → kept, missed by you, missed by them, called off or excused
features.failure: Standing them up costs trust and bond
features.notices: 'X Waited For You'; 'X Knows You're Ill'

tests.title: is excused, not standing them up

features.limitations: Classmates' reliability is drawn.

features.goal: Run lines with a classmate
features.entry: A classmate's invitation on the Coursework tab
features.prereqs: Their evening free; no clash
features.choices: Say yes or no; which shared scene
features.steps: An hour in New Haven
features.states: Invitation open → answered → session kept / missed / excused
features.notices: 'Ran Lines With X': which scene and how far the lines moved; or that nothing of yours moved
features.saveLoad: The scene chosen is on the scheduled item

tests.title: works on the scene you share with them
with no scene shared

features.limitations: None known.
features.initialGap: A session trained whichever scene was weakest, often another partner's.
features.resolution: Fixed: shared scenes only, chosen, said.

features.goal: Pass each course
features.entry: Standing tab: Courses And The Degree
features.prereqs: Meetings attended
features.steps: Meetings counted; settled at the term's evaluation
features.states: in progress → pass / incomplete / fail; incomplete → pass / permanent
features.failure: Unexcused attendance under three quarters, or half the work unshown: not passed
features.recovery: An Incomplete made up within its month
features.saveLoad: Saved; a save from before has no records and isn't judged by them

tests.title: an Incomplete in a course, made up
a course missed without excuse isn’t passed

features.limitations: The three-quarters line and two-hour sessions are SLATE's; no repeated course or added semester.
features.initialGap: No course had a record; the degree came with time in standing.

features.goal: Take the labs: Drama 50, the New Play Lab, You Are The Creator
features.prereqs: Their term
features.steps: Afternoon sessions; the solo showing judged
features.failure: Missed counts against attendance and the lab's pass

tests.title: runs Drama 50 in the first fall

features.limitations: Labs don't count toward the casting pool's missed calls, SLATE's reading of p.146.
features.initialGap: Missed labs never met any rule beyond attendance.

features.goal: Be cast and play a School production
features.prereqs: In the casting pool; from the second term
features.choices: Learn the part, review blocking, work notes
features.steps: Rehearsal stages to nights
features.failure: Missed calls take an actor out of the pool; a missed performance is a grave breach
features.recovery: Excused calls leave a blocking gap to catch up
features.consumers: Evaluation's work on stage; next casting reads delivery

tests.title: rehearses, misses and catches up, works the notes, and plays the nights on it

features.limitations: Which plays and dates are SLATE's; casting every student every term is SLATE's.

features.goal: Join a Yale Cabaret show
features.prereqs: Not on warning; not double-cast; a clear week three weeks off
features.steps: Evenings of rehearsal and a week of shows
features.failure: A warning during the show takes them out of what's left
features.recovery: None needed: nothing played is undone, no missed call charged
features.notices: 'Out Of The Cabaret Show'; the panel says why it can't be joined

tests.title: takes them out of a show still to come

features.limitations: The chair's approval is the refusals, not a separate request.
features.initialGap: The warning ban was checked only at joining.

features.goal: Work the assigned and elective work-study hours
features.prereqs: Registered (I-9); in term for elective; not on a night on call
features.steps: Saturday shifts; elective evenings; Friday pay
features.states: owedHours, electiveHours, shifts worked or missed
features.consumers: Evaluation; pay into the wages account; the return
features.notices: Payday; refusals said on the panel

tests.title: takes elective evenings

features.limitations: Saturday and Friday schedule is SLATE's; Yale's 19-hour weekly cap and the conversion of excused hours to grant aid aren't modeled.

features.goal: Stay in good standing
features.prereqs: End of a term's classes
features.steps: Courses settled, then evaluation
features.recovery: Meeting every floor restores good standing and the casting pool
features.notices: The standing notice, with the reasons

tests.title: a term’s coursework

features.limitations: Floors are SLATE's estimates.

features.goal: Leave the School: withdraw, or be dismissed
features.entry: Standing tab: Withdraw From The School (confirmed); dismissal by evaluation or breach
features.prereqs: Enrolled
features.steps: Place given up that day
features.costs: Early withdrawal refunds the term's Hospitalization premium
features.recovery: Readmission after withdrawal is in the Bulletin and not modeled
features.consumers: Yale Health (30 days, or canceled by day 15), F-1 grace (15 / none), OPT refused, work-study ends
features.notices: The standing notice, with each consequence

tests.title: a withdrawal by the fifteenth day
a dismissal leaves no grace

features.limitations: Dismissal's Yale Health rule is inferred from withdrawal's; a leave of absence isn't modeled.
features.initialGap: Withdrawal didn't exist; dismissal borrowed withdrawal's grace.

features.goal: Graduate
features.prereqs: Every course passed; not on warning after the last term
features.steps: Last evaluation, Commencement, or conferral on completing
features.failure: A course failed or permanently incomplete, or a final warning: withheld
features.recovery: An Incomplete made up after Commencement confers the degree without the ceremony
features.consumers: OPT, grace, Yale Health to 31 July
features.notices: 'Your MFA Is Conferred'; 'Not At Commencement'; 'The Degree Isn't Recommended'

tests.title: an Incomplete at Commencement
withholds the degree

features.limitations: No ninth semester or repeated course; a withheld degree ends school, said on the screen.

features.goal: Open a current account at another bank
features.entry: Money → Accounts → Open An Account At Another Bank
features.prereqs: A bank where you live; none there already; no charged-off debt; screening; photo ID; age; US person where the bank requires; a branch visit without an SSN
features.steps: Apply; Bank of America reviews two business days; fund; card arrives
features.costs: Opening deposit where asked; an hour in a branch without an SSN
features.states: application pending → open; awaitingFunds; card not yet arrived
features.failure: Refused with the reason; declined at review returns the deposit
features.recovery: Capital One closes unfunded at 60 days, Citi at zero 90 days
features.saveLoad: Applications and transfers are scheduled items

tests.title: opens Capital One at nothing
starts at a bank that opens for an F-1

features.limitations: Permanent residence isn't modeled, so US-persons-only reads citizenship; Citi's branch route for nonresidents isn't published.

features.goal: Move money between your banks
features.prereqs: Funds; savings allowances; the sending bank's limits
features.steps: Out now, in transit, in on arrival
features.recovery: Returned to the source if the destination closed
features.notices: On Its Way; 'A Transfer Came Back'

tests.title: can’t send money it doesn’t have

features.limitations: Pull transfers aren't modeled.

features.goal: Choose the primary account
features.prereqs: An open, not closing, current account
features.steps: Instant
features.consumers: Debit purchases, ATM cash, bills by hand, new instructions
features.notices: What it does and doesn't move

tests.title: keeps a save from before running as it ran

features.limitations: Overdraft and loans offered by the primary bank only.

features.goal: Have wages and school money paid elsewhere
features.prereqs: An open everyday account
features.steps: Payers move after their lead
features.consumers: Work-study (Yale payroll, 7 days), scholarship, benefits, refunds (14 days)
features.notices: Your Banks states where and from when
features.source: Yale payroll (one pay cycle); SLATE's 14-day estimate otherwise

tests.title: moves to the new account after one weekly pay cycle
a student changes banks

features.limitations: Only Yale payroll has its own lead; the scholarship's refund system's lead isn't published.

features.goal: Move standing orders and card autopay
features.prereqs: An open current account
features.steps: Instant
features.failure: Paid from a closed account: fails and says so
features.notices: Failure notices; Short For A Payment

tests.title: moves the primary account

features.limitations: None known.

features.goal: Close a current account
features.prereqs: Not only or primary; not overdrawn; nothing in transit or linked; no savings beside; no pending items (Citi waits up to 21 days)
features.steps: Interest and fees settled; balance remitted; closed

tests.title: is refused at Chase until they post

features.limitations: None known.
features.initialGap: Pending items never blocked closing (sign error); a Citi close past its limit failed halfway.

features.goal: Use a switching service
features.entry: Switch Bank (only where a service exists)
features.prereqs: A service country; not already at that bank
features.steps: The service's working days
features.failure: Refused in the US and other countries without one
features.saveLoad: Scheduled with the account it's for

tests.title: won’t switch into a bank already kept

features.limitations: A pending switch can't be cancelled.

features.goal: Be told which account needs attention
features.prereqs: None; low line set by the player
features.choices: Low line; Short For A Payment on or off
features.steps: Checked daily
features.recovery: Move money, change the source, cancel
features.notices: 'Low Balance: X'; 'Short For A Payment: X' naming payment, date, remedy

tests.title: warns once that Capital One is short

features.limitations: Three days is SLATE's design.
features.initialGap: The low-balance alert watched the primary only.

features.goal: Lock, report and renew each bank's debit card
features.prereqs: An open current account
features.choices: Lock, report lost or stolen, rush
features.steps: Stopped; replacement in the bank's days

tests.title: a second bank’s debit card can be locked

features.limitations: None known.
features.initialGap: Only the primary account's card could be managed.

features.goal: Get a Social Security number on an F-1
features.prereqs: F-1; registered for on-campus work; passport; in New Haven; out of hospital
features.steps: An hour at the office; the card in 21 days
features.consumers: Bank channel; ITIN wait on the return

tests.title: applies for the number once registered

features.limitations: Whether Yale pays before the card comes isn't published; SLATE pays.

features.goal: Keep lawful US status, and know its end
features.choices: Apply for OPT after the degree
features.steps: Status held while studying; grace after
features.failure: Out of status: marketplace ends, benefits refused
features.source: 8 CFR 214.2(f)(5)(iv), as in force (the 2026 rule stayed)

tests.title: a dismissal leaves no grace

features.limitations: Leaving the US isn't possible since travel went; an F-1 graduate without OPT goes out of status.

features.goal: Hold, lose and replace identity documents
features.prereqs: Per document
features.choices: Report lost or stolen; police report; replace
features.steps: Application and decision

tests.title: a lost passport leaves the F-1 status held

features.limitations: None known.
features.initialGap: A lost passport canceled the F-1; a replacement ID kept the theft record.

features.goal: Be covered and cared for
features.prereqs: Yale Health while enrolled
features.choices: Enroll when cover ends; care; prescriptions; therapy
features.steps: Care billed by the plan; bills paid or owed
features.failure: Enroll refused while Yale covers or a plan waits
features.recovery: Special enrollment within 60 days of losing cover; appeals; aid

tests.title: is admitted, billed

features.limitations: Retroactive cancellation's billing of care used isn't modeled.

features.goal: File the year's return and pay what's owed
features.prereqs: February each year
features.steps: File; refund or payment; collection if unpaid
features.recovery: Pay; file your own within the notice

tests.title: files a 1040-NR
is taxed in part

features.limitations: No partial payment; a substitute return can't be replaced once assessed.
features.initialGap: An F-1 student filed as a resident.

features.goal: Claim unemployment after school
features.prereqs: Covered wages; not a student in Connecticut; permission to work
features.steps: Weekly certification

tests.title: pays a noncitizen nothing without permission

features.limitations: The Summer Cabaret stipend is taken as covered, uncertain.

features.goal: Be compensated for an injury at school work
features.entry: Automatic on an injury at work
features.prereqs: An injury during paid school work
features.steps: Weekly benefit while off

tests.title: in Connecticut, where the school is

features.limitations: Work-study shifts carry no injury risk; student coverage under CGS 31-275 is SLATE's reading.
features.initialGap: New York's rules applied in New Haven.
